description: backup.run answers the manual run: the run view names what was made (the file's NAME, never its path — BK12), the level its own verify reached (a run never drills), the free-space state the check found, and whether the ledger took the row; the backup view is the SAME file in backup.list's own shape, so a client sees its fresh backup the way every other backup is shown, without a second call. verify:true is the per-call override of backup.verifyAfter; the reason is manual from this door by definition, and a caller naming another reason is refused (the identity keys likewise, before the actor is asked).
